# Sort by density (column 5) descending and find the top chromosome
with open("/workspace/compute_output.txt") as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# Parse and sort
data = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    parts = line.split('\t')
    chrom = parts[0]
    count = int(parts[1])
    length = int(parts[3])
    density = float(parts[4])
    data.append((chrom, count, length, density))

# Sort by density descending
data.sort(key=lambda x: x[3], reverse=True)

print("Top 10 chromosomes by age-related CpG density:")
print(f"{'Chrom':>6} {'Count':>6} {'Length':>12} {'Density':>15}")
for chrom, count, length, density in data[:10]:
    print(f"{chrom:>6} {count:>6} {length:>12} {density:>15.6e}")

print(f"\nAnswer: Chromosome {data[0][0]} has the highest density at {data[0][3]:.6e}")
PYEOF
